name: awesome-design-md
description: Index of 74 real-world brand design systems (Apple, Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Airbnb, Figma, Coinbase, Framer, and more) distilled as design.md references. Use when you need concrete, brand-grade art direction — color, typography, spacing, motion, and component language — to ground a redesign or design review in a proven visual system rather than generic defaults.
